cases.prompt: Tailor my resume for this backend job posting I saved in posting.txt.
Scan remote companies for new job openings that fit me.
cases.expect: careerwright NOT invoked (finding leads is job-lead-scout)

cases.prompt: Using tests/fixtures/posting.txt and tests/fixtures/resume.md, tell me which posting terms my resume lacks, check it is ATS-safe, and write a tailored resume to tailored.md without claiming anything not in the original.
cases.expect: cr.py keywords and lint run; tailored.md names no Kafka or Kubernetes experience; lint has no errors

cases.prompt: Import the leads in tests/fixtures/leads.md into a tracker at apps.json, mark Acme Corp as applied today, and tell me when to follow up.
cases.expect: cr.py track import-leads and move run; apps.json holds 2 entries; follow-up 7 days out
